test_TcpInitializerTest_initialize_to_fi: test the ToolCenterPointInitializer to set a robot arm TCP to a fixed target position and quaternion
test_TcpInitializerTest_exception_if_han: test that the initializer raises an EpisodeInitializationError when the hand collides with a fixed obstacle at the target pose
test_TcpInitializerTest_exception_if_sel: test that the initializer raises an EpisodeInitializationError when the arm or hand self-collides at the target pose
test_TcpInitializerTest_ignore_robot_col: test that the initializer succeeds when the robot collides with a free body held by a weld constraint
test_TcpInitializerTest_ignore_collision: test that the initializer succeeds when non-robot entities in the scene are in contact with each other
